title: Protocol for growing silica nanowires on various substrates to enhance superwetting and self-jumping properties
protocol: Set H2 and Ar gases at flow rates of 70 and 40 sccm, respectively, on metal foil samples.
Set the working pressure during the process at 5 Torr.
Heat the chamber to a growth temperature of 830°C after pressure stabilization.
Cool the furnace system to 510°C under Ar and H2 flow after growing the nanowires.
Turn off H2 for subsequent cooling when the temperature reaches 510°C.
Stop Ar gas flow and remove the samples when the temperature reaches 200°C.
Deposit a water drop on the surface of the sample to confirm the success of the F13-TCS treatment.
Set the hot plate temperature above the boiling point of F13-TCS (192°C) before injecting it into the Petri dish.
Inject 5-μL F13-TCS into the inverted Petri dish at 210°C.
